goal: Reduce requirement decision responsibilities before introducing any clarification layer while preserving the reconciled governance and execution mainline.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve main longitudinal governance and the reduced Capability, Interface, WorkNode, ProviderJob, Component, Artifact, and delivery contracts.
Requirement Decision emits detected signals and is not the canonical user-interaction authority.
Explicit tasks do not receive template-generated questions or uncertainties.
Canonical GoalSpec compilation is the only assumption authority.
ProjectPlan consumes only a GoalSpec that passes an explicit understanding-readiness boundary.
No Clarification Layer, second planning lane, or second execution abstraction is introduced.

prevention: Treat legacy question fields as projections only
assurance: Inventory producers and consumers before edits
Add negative tests for fabricated uncertainty
control: Run requirement, architecture, provider, kernel, and quick profiles
improvement: Freeze a factual reduction baseline before clarification design

interface_expectations: understanding readiness is checked before Project Planning
legacy decision_blockers and blocking_questions do not own interaction

feedback: Clarification reduction, requirement, architecture, provider, and kernel scoped tests passed.

experiments: Repair the independently reproduced generated-component quality message contract, then rerun the unchanged quick profile before promoting clarification readiness.
